$comment: Root schema. This $comment is the only one that survives minification.
title: Main

whole.$comment: External ref without fragment -> module is kept as a whole.

sub.$comment: External ref into a sub-def -> only that sub-def (and what it reaches) is kept.

local.$comment: Internal ref -> rewritten to #/$defs/main/$defs/mainLocal, so the root's own def entry must be emitted.

mainLocal.$comment: Referenced from main itself and from used-subdefs-only.
